question: Under the National Green Hydrogen Mission, what scheme was launched by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Green Hydrogen Certification Scheme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)** officially launched the **Green Hydrogen Certification Scheme** in **April 2025** to provide a transparent framework for certifying the origin and carbon intensity of hydrogen produced in India.
 
• The scheme is a pivotal part of the **National Green Hydrogen Mission (NGHM)**, which aims to position **India** as a global hub for the production, usage, and export of **Green Hydrogen** and its derivatives.
 
• The primary objective of this certification is to ensure that hydrogen production meets the specific **carbon intensity threshold**, which is defined as not exceeding **2 kg of Carbon Dioxide equivalent (CO2e)** per kg of hydrogen produced. ***Hence, the option Green Hydrogen Certification Scheme is the correct answer.***
